sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2026
sources.text: Duty engine crew onboard the ship underway noticed three robbers, armed with a knife in the engine room. Alarm raised, PA announcement made and crew mustered. On searching the ship, no robbers were found and all ship's items accounted for. The incident was reported to VTIS and the ship was instructed to proceed to the designated anchorage for further investigations. All crew reported safe.

While	 underway,	 five	 perpetrators	 boarded	
the ship. One of the perpetrators was 
armed with a knife. The ship’s general alarm 
was raised and crew mustered and accounted 
for. A search was carried out onboard with 
no further sightings of perpetrators. The 
crew were not injured. One crew’s mobile 
phone was stolen. 
The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. 
Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was 
carried out to warn all vessels to maintain 
a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The 
RSN	and	SPCG	were	notified	of	the	incident.	
Information was shared with the Indonesian 
authority.

While underway, three unarmed 
perpetrators were sighted on board the ship. 
The master initiated a security search with no 
perpetrators found onboard. The crew were 
not injured. Nothing was stolen.
The incident was reported to Singapore Port 
Operations Control Centre (POCC). The SPCG 
boarded the ship at Eastern Bunkering B 
Anchorage (AEBB) and conducted a search 
and investigation.
